issues.description: The problem statement's UML and task description specify addGuestStudents(int) as returning void, but the solution implementation defines addGuestStudents(int) to return boolean. This mismatch can confuse students about the expected signature and return value and may cause tests or grading code that expect a void method to fail.
issues.suggestedFix: Align the return type between specification and implementation. Either change the solution's addGuestStudents(int) to return void (and perform the update without returning a value) to match the UML and task description, or update the problem statement/UML to document that the method returns a boolean indicating success. Prefer updating the solution to void if tests expect the UML signature.
